programme.title: Forensic Files: Room with a View
programme.desc: A young woman is stabbed more than 100 times. The killer leaves DNA behind, but investigators must play a cat-and-mouse game to obtain a suspect's DNA to match.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dollars and Sense
programme.desc: On Christmas Eve 2005, a man's body is found burning near Baltimore. He's eventually identified as 26-year-old Wesley Person. Distinctive building materials from the 1930s play a crucial role in solving this case.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hair Line
programme.desc: Doctors don't know why a young scientist has fallen gravely ill. When tests finally reveal the cause, it's too late to save him.

programme.title: Forensic Files: All that Glitters is Gold
programme.desc: Police discover a bullet-riddled car, a missing driver and no witnesses. Had the victim been abducted or was she dead? The answers are found in a unique clue, so tiny it was measured in millionths of a meter.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Deadly Rebellion
programme.desc: Even though their daughter had run away before, she had always come back. Her parents were sure this time would be no different, but they were wrong.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sign of the Crime
programme.desc: In little more than a month, two women who lived in the same apartment complex were brutally murdered. The similarities of the crime scenes led police to conclude they were dealing with a serial killer who harbored an intense hatred of women.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Covet Thy Neighbour
programme.desc: When a college student vanished without a trace, her fellow students were concerned about her safety and their own.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Writing on the Wall
programme.desc: The victim was well liked and successful, which made the brutality of the crime even harder to understand.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hundreds of Reasons
programme.desc: An assistant manager of a Florida steakhouse is stabbed to death. It appears to be a robbery gone wrong, but a bloody fingerprint reveals that he knew his killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cold Feet
programme.desc: In 1985, Julie Estes was kidnapped from the Southside convenience store where she worked. Her body was found the next day, but the killing went unsolved until 2003.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Separation Anxiety
programme.desc: Tracey Frame, 35, was convicted of killing David Nixon in April 2002 after he planned to end their relationship.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Backstage Murder
programme.desc: In the 1980's, two partners created a nightclub that would bring them wealth and international fame. The male strip club phenomenon promised female patrons fun and excitement. But the bright lights hid a dark side.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Stranger
programme.desc: The body of a young woman found burned in a truck launched a manhunt to find her killer. When more bodies began to turn up across the country, the FBI believed the cases were linked. Investigators had a suspect. They just couldn't find him.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Manhunt
programme.desc: A killer was on the loose in one of America's most popular tourist destinations. Armed and desperate, he evaded law enforcement at every turn. As the Fourth of July weekend quickly approached, thousands of people became potential targets.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Crazy Don
programme.desc: To the FBI, he was believed to be the boss of New York's most powerful mafia organizationthe Genovese crime family. Was Gigante crazy or was his behavior a shrewd attempt to disguise his position as a ruthless mafia boss?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killer Abroad
programme.desc: Beginning in 1990, Europe found itself in the clutches of a serial killer. He became an international outlaw, hopping from country to country to evade capture and to kill again.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Shreds of Evidence
programme.desc: Hairs and Fibers: The tiniest filament can become a mark of distinction in the most singular and intimate of ways. Investigators have come to rely on forensic evidence as fine as a carpet fiber or as innocent as an eyelash to crack difficult cases.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Drawing Conclusions
programme.desc: A teenager is abducted on a shopping trip. Two hikers disappear from the Appalachian Trail.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Written in Blood
programme.desc: In North Carolina, the home of a prominent couple becomes an unlikely scene of terrible bloodshed. Across the country, a California woman vanishes, worrying her family and the investigators trying to find her.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Wasted Youth
programme.desc: When teenagers are driven to kill, their victims are but the first to fall. In three such cases, the families of the killers, as well as their communities, become the victims of violent crime.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Crimes Of Passion
programme.desc: When killers are driven by jealousy and desire, their desperation is evident in both the crime and their efforts to avoid detection. But forensic science can reveal even the slightest mistake to solve crimes of passion.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: 12 Years a Fugitive
programme.desc: When a beloved grandmother is found stabbed to death in her own home, Kenda must turn to a tight-knit community still grieving from the tragic loss.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Poker Face
programme.desc: A group of friends discover the corpse of entrepreneur Jamie Foster hidden under a blanket. Kenda e discovers that Foster’s business put him in close quarters with a host of unsavory characters.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: The Uninvited Guest
programme.desc: A soldier is stabbed to death at a drive-thru. Kenda’s only clue is that this is somehow tied to a breakdancing competition.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Who Took Heather?
programme.desc: A 13-year-old girl is missing, sending Kenda’s city into a panic. A cryptic letter to the District Attorney’s office suggests the girl isn’t the only victim.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Bad Blood
programme.desc: A army vet is found bleeding to death on the asphalt of a parking lot -- his chest littered with too many knife wounds to count. Kenda’s case is stuck in first gear until a gruesome clue appears.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Apollo Program Begins, Caves & Planck
programme.desc: The Apollo Program Begins - At the very beginning of NASA's moon project things go wrong. Caves - ESA's special training program for astronauts. Planck - Mapping the cosmic microwave background radiation.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Rebuilding Apollo, Orbiting Carbon & Zero Gravity Training
programme.desc: Rebuilding Project Apollo - After the Apollo 1 disaster NASA resumes manned space flight. Orbiting Carbon Observatory 2 - Monitoring the Earth's Co2 levels in unprecedented detail. Zero Gravity Training - Parabolic flights.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Beyond Earth Orbit, IXV Vehicles & Galileo Satellites Lost and Found
programme.desc: Beyond Earth Orbit - The Apollo program takes bold new steps. IXV Re-entry Vehicle - Europe is working to perfect a re-entry vehicle. Galileo Satellites Lost and Found - Navigation satellites go into incorrect orbit.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: To The Moon, SpaceX's Dragon and Falcon & GAIA
programme.desc: To the Moon - The Apollo program achieves its major objective. Dragon, Falcon and Spacex - New directions in re-usable spacecraft. Gaia- Mapping our galaxy in unprecedented detail.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Seasons of Saturn
programme.desc: Saturn is the second largest planet and has an astonishing 60 moons in its orbit. Thanks to the Cassini mission, it's also one of the most studied and most photographed planets in our neighborhood.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Vesta Unveiled
programme.desc: With the Dawn missions exploration of the asteroid Vesta and the dwarf planet Ceres, asteroids are a hot topic. See what these incredible missions have uncovered.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Water Worlds
programme.desc: The key ingredient to life in the universe is water. Until recently we thought Earth was the only place in the solar system to have any water at all. Now that probes are peering around nearby worlds we are finding that is just not the case.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Gravity
programme.desc: Gravity has long been a force that has intrigued scientists. Now, for the first time scientists are probing to detect gravity waves in space as well as mapping the gravity patterns of the moon.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Science and the Shuttle
programme.desc: For more than 25 years the shuttle was our ticket to space, and our laboratory in orbit. Uncover the legacy of this amazing machine, and see what lies ahead.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Landing on Mars
programme.desc: Mars sparks our curiosity like no other planet because it is so reachable. Despite having landed there, most of the information we gather is still done by instruments in the planet's orbit.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Living with Space
programme.desc: Astronauts and Cosmonauts train and study for years to work and live aboard the International Space Station. With this wealth of experience and insight behind them what do they think when they return to Earth?

programme.title: Unsolved Murders
programme.desc: In 1992, Sylviane Kaas was found dead in her bedroom. Her husband had been the prime suspect for several years. Now exonerated, this murder remains unpunished.

programme.title: Unsolved Murders
programme.desc: July 2000, Vaucluse, a few kilometers from Avignon. Richard Alessandri, 42, a wealthy supermarket owner, is shot dead in his sleep. Everything suggests that it was a home-jacking gone wrong.

programme.title: Unsolved Murders
programme.desc: A veterinarian rushes home because his wife, with whom he had an appointment for lunch in a local brasserie, is no longer answering her phone. He discovers his wife's body lying in her blood in the bathtub.

programme.title: Cops: Dead End Dash
programme.desc: An officer tracks a suspect down a treacherous cliffside, a man puts his brother and elderly father at risk, and a man asks police to take his son to jail.

programme.title: Cops: Four Felonies and a Flat Tire
programme.desc: A suspected car thief's claims of innocence are undermined by a video he shot of himself earlier that day, and the pursuit of a suspected drunk driver has a surprising end.

programme.title: Cops: Pants Party
programme.desc: A car eludes a DUI checkpoint only to crash, one woman takes the fall for everyone in her group, and a man hides his stash in the one place he thinks police will never look.

programme.title: Cops: Smooth Move
programme.desc: A shifty suspect claims he wasn't the driver of a wrecked vehicle police were pursuing, and a detained cyclist attempts a tricky maneuver to rid himself of damning evidence.

programme.title: Cops: Highway to Jail
programme.desc: Reckless ATV drivers lead police on a dangerous chase through the streets of Atlanta, and a man worried about warrants lies about his identity to police during a traffic stop.

programme.title: Cops: Dishonest Dudes
programme.desc: Torrential rain hampers the pursuit of a fleeing vehicle, a man on a moped is carrying more than he lets on, and a persistent police officer unravels a sketchy man's story.

programme.title: Cops: Fighting to Lose
programme.desc: Shots fired in a park after hours leads to a messy situation for one officer, and a disturbed man with a gun takes responding officers on a harrowing chase.

programme.title: Cops: Mom Still Loves You
programme.desc: Officers track down a suspect who eluded them earlier, a suspicious vehicle takes off at the sight of police, and a man gets busted for possession in front of his mom.

programme.title: Cops: The Young and the Reckless
programme.desc: Police catch up to a man with warrants and a history of resisting arrest, a fidgety driver arouses suspicion, and a minor with beers in his pants has to answer to his mom.

programme.title: Cops: Too Many Cooks
programme.desc: A fleeing driver becomes cooperative once he reaches his destination, a woman gets feisty with police, and police respond to a domestic dispute involving a frying pan.

programme.title: Cops: Second Time Around
programme.desc: Deputies are led on a chase by a driver they pursued just weeks earlier, and a man caught with drugs tries to pin the blame on his girlfriend.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Savage Murder of a Mother and her Daughter (Amato Case)
programme.desc: On March 31, 2003, firefighters were called to a fire in a housing estate of Meyrargues, near Aix-en-Provence. On site, they discovered a horrific scene: the tortured and charred bodies of a mother and her daughter, Chantal and Audrey D'Amato.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: A Dire Deception (Laurence Maille Case)
programme.desc: On November 28, 2007, Laurence Maille disappeared. It was her partner, John Zablevski, who alerted the Vimy police in Pas-de-Calais. He explained that the young woman had left in the morning for a walk with their dog and never returned.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Stabed In Her Bed: The Maureen Jaquier Case
programme.desc: On February 27, 2015, in Toulouse, the parents of 19-year-old Maureen Jacquier discover their daughter stabbed several times in her bed.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Shot At Point-Blank: The Aurelie Barbot Affair
programme.desc: On December 20, 2012, in Val d'Izé (Ille-et-Vilaine), Aurélie Barbot, 29, was killed on her doorstep with a bullet to the head.

programme.title: Norske Krimsaker: Episode 102
programme.desc: Åtte år gamle Monika Sviglinskaja blir funnet død i sitt hjem på Sotra. Politiet mener det dreier seg om et selvmord og henlegger saken. Men moren hennes er fortsatt overbevist om at noe kriminelt har skjedd.

programme.title: Norske Krimsaker: Episode 103
programme.desc: To turgåere finner et utbrent lik på et bål langs en øde skogsbilvei på Veståsen i Søndre Land. I flere uker står politiet helt uten svar på hvem som kan stå bak den groteske handlingen.

programme.title: Norske Krimsaker: Episode 104
programme.desc: 10. august 2019 opplevde Norge nok et rystende terrorangrep. 21 år gamle Philip Manshaus dreper først sin 17 år gamle stesøster. Bevæpnet, og med uniform går han deretter til angrep mot Al-Noor moskeen i Bærum.

programme.title: Norske Krimsaker: Episode 105
programme.desc: Tina Jørgensen forsvant etter en kveld på byen i Stavanger. En måned senere finner politiet liket av en 20 år gammel kvinne. Hvem kan ha tatt livet av Tina og deretter dumpet henne langs en øde veistrekning?

programme.title: Svenske krimsaker: Episode 601
programme.desc: Den 14. november 2019 forsvinner sytten år gamle Wilma, og hele Uddevalla blir involvert i forsvinningen. Etter noen dager blir det funnet blod i hennes og kjærestens leilighet, men Wilma er fortsatt savnet.

programme.title: Svenske krimsaker: Episode 602
programme.desc: En regnfull morgen den 19. oktober 2004 dreper en ukjent mann en åtte år gammel gutt og en 56 år gammel kvinne i Linköping. Gjerningsmannen forsvinner sporløst og politiet må nå finne ut hvem han er.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Fare på Dobbel Date
programme.desc: Når niesen til frøken Shapen, Noelle, kommer til byen og velger Jasper og ikke Henry, oppdager Henry at Noelle har større planer enn bare å gå ut på middag med Jasper.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Lisens til å fly
programme.desc: Ray gir Harvey lov til å fly helikopteret hans, men så blir det for mye for Ray og han begynner å oppføre seg som en nervøs forelder. Charlotte, Jasper og Piper finner en sukkerspinn-maskin i Skrot & Sånn og starter å lage sukkerspinn.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Swellviews Talenter
programme.desc: Når de oppdager at deltagerne på Swellviews Talenter mister bevisstheten, må Captain Man og Kid Danger få hjelp av Charlotte og Schwoz for å finne ut hva som er årsaken til at det skjer.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Sittende fast i hull
programme.desc: HVAAAA?! Captain man og Kid Danger sitter begge fast i et hull? Charlotte og Jasper er nødt til å hjelpe for Scwoz tar et bønnebad.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Dommedagens Ballonger
programme.desc: Når Dr. Minyak kidnapper fansen til The Man, må Captain Man og Kid Danger finne en måte å redde dem på uten at Dr. Minyak ser at de beveger seg.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Live og Farlig Del 1
programme.desc: Captain Man og Kid Danger blir invitert på party av en kjent Internett-kjendis, men når de ankommer oppdager de at selskapet ikke er hva det ser ut som det er. I mellomtiden er Charlotte barnevakt for Piper.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Live & Dangerous: Del 2
programme.desc: Frankini har annonsert sin plan om å finne ut hvem Kid Danger og Captain Man er. Charlotte, Schwoz, Jasper og Piper må slå seg sammen for å stoppe Frankini før identiteten til Kid Danger og Captain Man's blir avslørt for alle!

programme.title: Henry Danger: Game Dangers del 1
programme.desc: Frustrert over sine feilslåtte skurkestreker planlegger Dr. Minyak og ødelegge den verdensomspennende veldedighetskonserten til Double G. Captain Man, Kid Danger og Game shakers slår seg sammen for å overvinne Dr Minyak og holde Double G trygg.

programme.title: iCarly: Det spøker på Halloween
programme.desc: Carly, Sam og Freddie sender iCarly fra en leilighet som det sies at det spøker i. Når det begynner å skje nifse ting, begynner også vennene å bli redde for at spøkelsesryktene er sanne.

programme.title: iCarly: En dag jeg vil angre
programme.desc: Spencer redder livet til hovedsangeren i The Plain White T's og får ham til å gå med på å delta i iCarly. Merkelige ting begynner å gå feil midt i Carlys, Sams og Freddies nettvideosending.

programme.title: iCarly: Gjensittingen
programme.desc: Sam må sitte igjen den kvelden iCarly holder sin 50. nettvideospesialsending. Carly og Freddie kan da altså ikke gjøre som de pleier, så de prøver så godt de kan å få gjennsitting de også, så de kan sende fra skolebenken med Sam.

programme.title: iCarly: Fotsår reklame
programme.desc: Carly, Sam og Freddie blir invitert til Dakas hovedkvarter, der de blir tilbudt en stor pengesum får å gå god for Dakas nye sko, Tech-foten, på iCarly. Men det viser seg at skoene er forferdelige.

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg lover å ikke sladre
programme.desc: Carly får en B på historieprøven hun burde ha fått en A på. Sam, som griper sjansen på sitt ukentlige møte med rektor Franklin, forandrer Carlys karakter på datamaskinen og overrasker henne med A blank.

programme.title: iCarly: iCarly redder TV
programme.desc: En prestisjetung produsent vil gjøre iCarly om til et TV-show. Men Carly, Sam og Freddie blir raskt fortvilet når de hører om alle de store forandringene produsenten ønsker å foreta.

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg hater Sams kjæreste
programme.desc: Sam får en kjæreste og de to blir uadskillelige. Men når forholdet begynner å få følger for iCarly, forstår Carly og Freddie at de må gjøre noe.

programme.title: iCarly: Overvåket
programme.desc: Etter å ha sett et klipp på iCarly der en mann selger illegale piratkopivideoer, bestemmer to detektiver seg for å bruke Carly og Spencers loft for overvåking.

programme.title: iCarly: Skolebytte
programme.desc: Carly får vite at hun får mulighet til å få et fullt stipend til en privat eliteskole pga nettshowet sitt. Skolen er Briarwood. Carly er i sterk tvil, men Sam og Freddie vet de må få henne til å gå for det.

programme.title: iCarly: Fektedrama
programme.desc: Freddie trenger litt guttetid, så han slår seg sammen med Spencer for å dra og fekte. Freddie er et naturtalent, men ting blir innviklet når Spencer får ham med i en kamp mot den utrolige Doug Toder.

programme.title: McLeods døtre: Episode 314
programme.desc: Ulykke rammer Drovers når Jodi kaster et kjedebrev. Har hun sluppet løs en forbannelse?

programme.title: Fangene på Fortet: Episode 1104
programme.desc: Det blir humor, spenning og høyt volum i dagens duell. Med Leif Einar "Lothepus" Lothe, Fetisha Williams og hennes far Byron Williams på det røde laget, og Fritjof Wilborn, Trude Mostue og Egil Andreas Skurdal på det blå laget.

programme.title: Fangene på Fortet: Episode 1105
programme.desc: Det er duket for to ekstremt sterke lag i dagens duell. Kampsport-gjengen med Emil Meek og Margaret Aase har med seg Lasse Matberg, og skal kjempe mot iskrigerne Colin Olsen, Jørgen Karterud og legenden Jan Tore Kjær.

programme.title: Fangene på Fortet: Episode 1106
programme.desc: Det er to lag fulle av energi og sjarm som møter hverandre i dagens duell. På det røde laget finner vi Nate Khungu, Dennis Siva Lie og Sølje Bergman, som skal kjempe mot Grace Bullen, Morten Thorsen og Lene Alexandra.

programme.title: Fangene på Fortet: Episode 1107
programme.desc: En gjeng gourmetkokker møter en gjeng fryktløse fartsfantomer. Christer Rødseth, Christoffer Davidsen og Trond Moi møter rallyfører Mads Østberg, artist Raylee og snøscooterkjører Marie Sandberg.

programme.title: Fangene på Fortet: Episode 1108
programme.desc: Det er lagspillere mot individualister som skal i duell. På det røde fotballaget møter vi Jan Gunnar Solli, Solveig Guldbrandsen og Tobias Becks. På det blå laget finner vi Rasmus Wold, Genette Våge og Victoria Tolaas.

programme.title: South Park: Mecha Streisand
programme.desc: Cartman og Kyle krangler om et magisk triangel som kan forvandle Barbra Streisand til et fryktelig monster.

programme.title: South Park: Mysterion reiser seg
programme.desc: Ført an av 'Mysterion', jobber 'Coon' og vennene hans med å hjelpe folk i Gulfen. Og 'Coon' er ute etter hevn.

programme.title: South Park: Kyllingelskeren
programme.desc: Barbrady ber guttene om hjelp til å løse en sak, og Cartman lar seg rive med av sin nye autoritet.

programme.title: South Park: Cartman får en analundersøkelse
programme.desc: Cartman drømmer at han møter et romvesen, men de andre guttene er sikre på at drømmen var virkelighet.

programme.title: South Park: En stige til himmelen
programme.desc: Guttene bryter seg inn for å stjele urnen med Kennys aske.

programme.title: South Park: Hyllusinasjoner
programme.desc: De hysteriske foreldrene i South Park får enda en grunn til panikk når 'cheesing' blir poplært blant barna.

programme.title: South Park: Selvantenning
programme.desc: Innbyggerne i South Park begynner å eksplodere uten forvarsel. Stans far tar saken.

programme.title: South Park: Øyekatarr
programme.desc: Det er Halloween i South Park, og Kenny blir drept av en styrtende romstasjon og forvandlet til en zombie, ved hjelp av balsameringsvæske og Worcestersaus.

programme.title: South Park: Universets største drittsekk
programme.desc: Cartman føler seg ikke bra etter å ha drukket Kennys aske og blitt besatt av sjelen hans, og sendes til sykehuset.

programme.title: South Park: Du har null venner
programme.desc: Mot bedre vitende, blir Stan med på Facebook og blir en sosialt nettworkende 'juggernaut', noe som forårsaker at han selv blir sugd inn i websiden.

programme.title: South Park: Guitar Queer-O
programme.desc: Stan og Kyle står overfor sitt store gjennombrudd med Guitar Hero-ferdighetene sine. Manageren deres overbeviser Stan om at Kyle holder ham tilbake, og skaper spenninger mellom dem.

programme.title: South Park: Utlogget
programme.desc: Forvirring og panikk råder da Internett blir borte i South Park!

programme.title: South Park: Du holder på å bli gammel
programme.desc: Når Stan får en Tween Wave-CD til burdag, gir foreldrene ham forbud om å lytte til det 'søppelet'. Stan begynner å bli enig med dem, men vennene hans lar seg ikke imponere.

programme.title: South Park: Alt om mormonere?
programme.desc: En ny gutt, Gary, flytter til South Park, og familien hans er mormonere. Eric blir venn med ham, men blir skuffet over mormonismen.

programme.title: South Park: Mitt fremtidige meg
programme.desc: South Park blir rammet av en kraftig storm, og en naken fremmed påstår at han er Stan fra fremtiden.

programme.title: South Park: Døden
programme.desc: Stans bestefar prøver å lure guttene til å drepe ham. Foreldrene i South Park prøver å få stanset sendingene av 'Terrance and Phillip'.

programme.title: South Park: Fåraktig
programme.desc: Mens han er på en gruppeterapitime mot hamstring, blir Stan fanget i en drøm om skolerådgiveren Mr. Mackey.

programme.title: South Park: Crème Fraiche
programme.desc: Irritert over Randys perverse besettelse med matlagningsprogrammer, søker Stan Gordon Ramseys hjelp. Jamie Oliver er ikke like hjelpsom.

programme.title: South Park: Stanleys cup
programme.desc: Stan blir hockeytrener og prøver å skape et vinnerlag.

programme.title: South Park: Buddha Box
programme.desc: Cartman har fått en angstdiagnose.

programme.title: South Park: Zimmermans verdenskrig
programme.desc: Cartman anser Token for å være en trussel mot hele menneskeheten.

programme.title: South Park: Fattig og dum
programme.desc: Cartmans nye ambisjon her i livet er at han vil bli en NASCAR-kjører. Klarer Cartman å vinne sitt livs race?

programme.title: South Park: Cartmans teite hatkriminalitet 2000
programme.desc: FBI etterforsker Cartman for hatkriminalitet etter at han har kastet en stein på Token.

programme.title: South Park: City People
programme.desc: Da moren får en ny jobb blir Cartman misfornøyd.

programme.title: South Park: Tsst!
programme.desc: Cartmans mor innser at hun ikke har kontroll på sønnen sin og søker eksperthjelp fra hundehviskeren Cesar Millan.

programme.title: South Park: Coon
programme.desc: Om dagen er han Eric Cartman, en feit gutt i 4. klasse. Om kvelden er han The Coon, en feit forbryterbekjemper og borgerverner som er utkledd som vaskebjørn og desperat etter oppmerksomhet.

programme.title: South Park: Kaptein Tjukkskjegg
programme.desc: Cartman har hørt om alle de rikdommene som blir plyndret av pirater i Somalia, så han setter en lapp over øyet og sleper gjengen med til Afrika for å få en bit av kaka.

programme.title: South Park: Medisinsk fritert kylling
programme.desc: Cartman blir rasende når han finner ut at hans yndlingsrestaurant er omgjort til en medisinsk marihuana-utlevering. Randy er ikke like skuffet.

programme.title: South Park: Slipp taket og styr
programme.desc: Cartman infiltrerer NSA for å avsløre dem og blir slett ikke glad for hva han finner i sin egen mappe.

programme.title: South Park: Hva skjer med landet?
programme.desc: Garrison vil bygge en mur for å holde alle immigrantene uten dokumentasjon ute.

programme.title: South Park: Casa Bonita
programme.desc: Kyle ber Butters i stedet for Cartman til bursdagsfest. Cartman overbeviser Butters om at en meteoritt vil treffe jorden, og gjemmer ham i et tilfluktsrom så han kan gå i stedet.

programme.title: South Park: Rosiner
programme.desc: Stan blir dumpet av Wendy og blir goth for å leve ut smerten.

programme.title: South Park: Marjorine
programme.desc: Cartman er overbevist om at jentene har en dings som kan spå fremtiden, så Butters kler seg ut for å infiltrere deres rekker.

programme.title: South Park: Den siste meksikaner
programme.desc: Da en grensepatruljelek går galt, ender Butters opp med å gjenopplive den meksikanske stoltheten, men Cartman er forberedt på å la leken slutte der.

programme.title: South Park: Virtuelt vindaloopet
programme.desc: Butters er overbevist om at han lever i en virtuell verden.

programme.title: South Park: Moro med kampsportvåpen
programme.desc: Guttene kjøper våpen på et loppemarked og blir forvandlet til japanske anime-krigere, med alvorlige konsekvenser for stakkars Butters.

programme.title: South Park: Tilbakekomsten av Ringenes herre til de to tårn
programme.desc: Guttene kler seg i 'Ringenes herre'-kostymer og drar ut på eventyr.

programme.title: South Park: Cartman suger
programme.desc: Butters blir sett i en kompromitterende stilling med Cartman og sendes til omvendingsleir for homofile. Cartman prøver å få tilbake et bilde av det som skjedde.

programme.title: South Park: Streik
programme.desc: Gutta melder Butters på som gjest i et populært talkshow der folk med deformiteter medvirker.

programme.title: South Park: Mecha Streisand
programme.desc: Cartman og Kyle krangler om et magisk triangel som kan forvandle Barbra Streisand til et fryktelig monster.

programme.title: South Park: Cartman finner kjærligheten
programme.desc: Cartman spiller matchmaker når en ny jente flytter til South Park.

programme.title: South Park: Ikes tissefant
programme.desc: Kyle prøver å forhindre at lillebrorens penis blir skåret av.

programme.title: South Park: Du yelper ikke til
programme.desc: Cartman ser seg som den beste restaurantkritikeren på nettet i South Park.

programme.title: South Park: Fantasilandet III
programme.desc: Stan og Butters er fanget i Imaginationland og må kjempe for livet mot en hær av onde krefter. Kyle og Cartman er fortsatt i Pentagon.

programme.title: South Park: #Oppkok
programme.desc: Kyle vil bare spille tv-spill med lillebroren sin. Men da Ike vil ikke spille med ham mer, blir Kyle redd for at neste generasjon vil forbigå ham.

programme.title: South Park: Fantasilandet I
programme.desc: Guttene kommer til et magisk land der hele verdens fantasi ligger foran dem, men terroristplaner truer med å ødelegge alt sammen.

programme.title: South Park: Vesenet
programme.desc: Kyles fetter Kyle Schwartz flytter til South Park på grunn av morens helseproblemer. Til å begynne med er Kyle glad for besøket, men det går ikke lang tid før 'Kyle 2' begynner å irritere ham.

programme.title: South Park: Mr. Garrisons nye vakre vagina
programme.desc: Mr. Garrison skifter kjønn, og Kyle får en 'uvanlig' operasjon som gjør ham høy og sprek nok til å komme på basketballaget.

programme.title: South Park: Se opp for de selvgode!
programme.desc: South Parks innbyggere kjøper hybridbiler, men idet folk begynner å føle seg fornøyde fordi de redder verden, samler en mørk sky seg over byen.

programme.desc: When mom and dad go camping, the kids throw a party and quickly lose control.

programme.title: 7th Heaven
programme.desc: The school bully experiences a severe lapse in judgment when he tries to bully Mary.

programme.title: 7th Heaven
programme.desc: Camille, a beautiful girl with a wild reputation, befriends Mary, and starts to influence her behavior.

programme.title: 7th Heaven
programme.desc: Eric puts his job on the line to help an ex-con with his problems.

programme.title: 7th Heaven
programme.desc: Eric's parents come to visit and almost lose their newly adopted son George.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: Long before the first funeral home was established in Manchester, Kentucky in 1938, there was the Chestnut House. The Chestnut family dedicated one of the home’s parlors to store the caskets they made.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: Located on the historic site of Perryville Battlefield, it’s believed that the Karrick-Parks House is home to the souls of some 7,600 soldiers who were killed, wounded, or missing in Kentucky’s most destructive Civil War Battle.

programme.title: Past Hunters: The Haunted Parade
programme.desc: Derek Acorah’s The Past Hunters travel to Hoylake and investigate a building known as The Parade. Dating back to 1909, this once former school, still seems to have ghostly pupils and teachers taking class.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Knutsford Crown Court – Part 1
programme.desc: Derek Acorah’s The Past Hunters travel to Knutsford and investigate a former Crown Court. Multiple people have been sentenced to death and life in prison, but will the team encounter any of its former inmates tonight?

programme.title: Past Hunters: Knutsford Crown Court – Part 2
programme.desc: Derek Acorah’s The Past Hunters continue their investigation of Knutsford Crown Court. As they delve deeper into the building, will the ghosts and spirits make contact through Derek?

programme.title: Past Hunters: The Haunted Mill – Part 1
programme.desc: Derek Acorah’s The Past Hunters travel to Stockport and investigate an abandoned Mill, Weir Mill, said to the most haunted Mill in the UK. Demonic figures haunt anyone that enters. Will the team survive the night with the spirits?

programme.title: Iron Chef
programme.desc: No holds are barred in this seafood wrestling match. Who can get their arms around octopus better, Iron Chef Kobe or Challenger Hiromichi Yoneda?

programme.title: Iron Chef

programme.desc: Rachael Mullenix, 19, was convicted of stabbing her mother, Barbara Mullenix, in 2006. She allegedly packed her mother's bloodied corpse in a cardboard box before dumping it in California's Newport Bay.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Watchful Eye
programme.desc: On May 20, 2001, Carrie Nelson was beaten to death while working alone in a park office. The case went unsolved for six years. Finally, police found a match with DNA samples gathered from the crime scene.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Waste Mis-Management
programme.desc: Foul play is suspected when Fort Worth factory worker Glenda Furch disappears after completing her shift.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dirty Little Secret
programme.desc: Police get a clue about a couple who disappeared on Memorial Day weekend during an in-progress robbery. The evidence found solves a brutal crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Lights Out
programme.desc: In this episode, the decade-old murder of a young Texas housewife is investigated.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Pet Rock
programme.desc: In 1995, Palm Beach waitress Denise O'Neill is abducted and murdered. Her neighbor Luis Caballero arouses suspicions by behaving oddly towards TV crews covering the crime.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killer Abroad
programme.desc: Beginning in 1990, Europe found itself in the clutches of a serial killer. He became an international outlaw, hopping from country to country to evade capture and to kill again.

programme.title: The FBI Files: .22 Caliber Killer
programme.desc: In Buffalo, New York, a sniper targeted African-American men. He held a city hostage, and threatened to ignite a racial powder keg. And it looked like others might be following his bloody example.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Held For Ransom
programme.desc: Wealth has its rewards, but it also brings its dangers. Kidnapping is one of them. No ordeal is more horrifying for a family than to have a child taken.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise
programme.desc: It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Crimes Of Passion
programme.desc: When killers are driven by jealousy and desire, their desperation is evident in both the crime and their efforts to avoid detection. But forensic science can reveal even the slightest mistake to solve crimes of passion.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Cold Cases
programme.desc: These cases took a decade or more to solve. There's no statute of limitations on murder. As a case turns cold, the clues become scarce, investigators must rely on science to close cold cases.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Raw Greed
programme.desc: A friendly Midwest lodge becomes the scene of a gruesome double murder. Two men are dead and a safe filled with cash is missing.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Grave Secrets
programme.desc: Killers often attempt to deflect attention away from their crimes by hiding the remains of their victims. Bodies may lay hidden for years before they are discovered.

programme.title: The New Detectives: The Unforgotten
programme.desc: Years after a murder has been committed, investigators use advanced DNA analysis to shed new light on crimes that have gone unpunished for far too long.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Bad Blood
programme.desc: A army vet is found bleeding to death on the asphalt of a parking lot -- his chest littered with too many knife wounds to count. Kenda’s case is stuck in first gear until a gruesome clue appears.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: The End
programme.desc: Kenda faces his most difficult case yet – the slaying of a young boy. The detective makes the most consequential decision of his career.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: When the Music Stops
programme.desc: Vietnam War veteran Charles Walker is found unconscious, after a stabbing attack so savage even 45 units of blood couldn’t save his life.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: The Monster Awakes
programme.desc: When Julie Smith reports being sexually assaulted, Lt. Joe Kenda and his Sex Crimes Unit discover a terrifying similarity to other attacks on the east side of town.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Last Fare
programme.desc: A young man is found dead behind the wheel of his taxi. With robbery seeming unlikely, Kenda and Gaenzle wonder if this was personal.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Living with Space
programme.desc: Astronauts and Cosmonauts train and study for years to work and live aboard the International Space Station. With this wealth of experience and insight behind them what do they think when they return to Earth?

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Atmosphere
programme.desc: Our atmosphere is an unbelievably complex machine that protects us from the vacuum of space, shelters us from harmful radiation and allows us and the biosphere to breath; we need to learn much more about it so we can better it.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Flight Status
programme.desc: The next 12 months will see an intense rise in flight tests, demonstration launches and high priority flights. Some are on time others are not. We check the flight status of some of this new hardware and these new capabilities.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Invasion Mars
programme.desc: For over 50 years we have bombarded Mars with our probes and landers. Spying from orbit to map terrain, finding her strengths and weaknesses. The time nearing for the full scale invasion of the planet, when humans walk on Mars and claim it for their own.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Juno, Cassini and Beyond
programme.desc: The Amazing Cassini spacecraft and its sibling lander, Huygens, have now concluded their scientific studies, bringing back years of data. Now, Juno piercing the cloak of Jupiter and her distant relative New Horizons at the edge of the solar system.

programme.title: The Mystery of Dark Matter
programme.desc: Dark matter, which is unknown and undetectable in our physical models, would appear to populate the cosmos on a massive scale. For the first time, a film portrays the wild scientific quest that dark matter gives rise to - a real thriller!

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Beginning of the End, Apollo Gets Complicated & The End of Apollo
programme.desc: The Beginning of the End - After the first Moon landing the Apollo science program was about to start in earnest but people were losing interest. Apollo Gets Complicated - New technology is added that extends the reach of the Apollo program.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Shuttle Program, The Challenger Disaster & Return to Space
programme.desc: The Shuttle Program - The first re-useable spacecraft. The Challenger Disaster - Pressing launch schedules lead to carelessness and the loss of the Challenger. Return to Space - A re-designed shuttle is back in space with a redefined role.

programme.title: Unsolved Murders
programme.desc: A veterinarian rushes home because his wife, with whom he had an appointment for lunch in a local brasserie, is no longer answering her phone. He discovers his wife's body lying in her blood in the bathtub.

programme.title: Unsolved Murders
programme.desc: It was exactly 32 years ago! The Anaïs Marcelli case, named after this 10-year-old girl abducted on January 14, 1991 as she left school in Mulhouse, has just been taken over by the Nanterre cold case unit.

programme.title: Buzzfeed Unsolved: The Creepy Murder in Room 1046
programme.desc: Ryan and Shane examine the bizarre encounters and baffling twists of the death of Roland T. Owen in Room 1046.

programme.title: Buzzfeed Unsolved: The Strange Drowning of Natalie Wood
programme.desc: Ryan and Shane dive into the eerie circumstances involved in the mystery Natalie Wood's tragic drowning.

programme.title: Buzzfeed Unsolved: The Mysterious Poisoned Pill Murders / The Disturbing Murders at Keddie Cabin
programme.desc: Ryan and Shane discuss the bizarre case of the Tylenol murders and the truth behind the Keddie Cabin murders.

programme.title: Cops: Second Time Around
programme.desc: Deputies are led on a chase by a driver they pursued just weeks earlier, and a man caught with drugs tries to pin the blame on his girlfriend.

programme.title: Cops: Party in a Box
programme.desc: Officers review dashcam footage after a suspect claims force was used against him unjustly, and a weed enthusiast drops some knowledge on police about the founding fathers.

programme.title: Cops: Two in the Bush
programme.desc: A woman leads police on a dangerous chase, a driver is remorseful for the damage he's caused, and a man's denial of solicitation is undermined by his open fly.

programme.title: Cops: Undeniably Fishy
programme.desc: A man loses his friend and finds trouble, officers stop a vehicle they believe was involved in a shooting, and a suspicious vehicle leads to a suspicious story.

programme.title: Cops: Nothing to See Here
programme.desc: A man's mole gives him away when he tries to fool police with a fake name, a drunken man shows officers he has nothing to hide, and a reckless driver imperils a neighborhood.

programme.title: Cops: Bible Buddies
programme.desc: Numerous patrol cars give chase to a man on a dirt bike refusing to yield, and an alleged armed robber is upfront about his reasons for running from police when approached.

programme.title: Cops: Shaking Like a Paint Mixer
programme.desc: A man blames the weed found in his car on his absent nephew, a suspect in custody starts to convulse, and police respond to a call about an armed man tripping on bath salts.

programme.title: Cops: Love Gone Bad
programme.desc: A man on a dirt bike tries to elude police while dumping his firearm, and after breaking up a parking lot drug deal, an officer advises a young suspect to make better choices.

programme.title: Cops: Crying Over Spilled Milk
programme.desc: After chasing down a suspect on foot, officers retrieve a fully loaded revolver from his pants, and police respond to a call about a man wielding a knife outside a bar.

programme.title: Cops: Front Door Felony
programme.desc: A fleeing motorcyclist tries to outsmart officers by hiding his bike in a retail garden area, and a concerned citizen reports seeing a man steal a package from a porch.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Shot At Point-Blank: The Aurelie Barbot Affair
programme.desc: On December 20, 2012, in Val d'Izé (Ille-et-Vilaine), Aurélie Barbot, 29, was killed on her doorstep with a bullet to the head.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Crime Scene Solvers: Honeymoon Killers (Van Beers Case)
programme.desc: Marc Van Beers, a 36-year old Brussels tax lawyer, dies in a road accident while on honeymoon. His wife Aurore is unharmed by the accident.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Laurence Dromard Case
programme.desc: Sylvain Dromard finds the body of his wife Laurence lying in a pool of blood in the kitchen. The crime was particularly violent and the theory of a burglary that went wrong is soon excluded. But investigators don't understand who could want her dead.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Two Young Women Massacred: The Leconte Affair
programme.desc: On July 8, 2002, near Amiens, a farmer discovers the lifeless body of a young woman, Patricia Leclercq, on his field.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Shot In the While Sleeping (Richard Alessandri Case)
programme.desc: On the night of July 16, 2000, the life of Edwige Alessandri changed forever. She made a frantic emergency call in the town of Carpentras. She recounted that some men burst into her room and shot her husband while he slept.

programme.title: Svenske krimsaker: Episode 602
programme.desc: En regnfull morgen den 19. oktober 2004 dreper en ukjent mann en åtte år gammel gutt og en 56 år gammel kvinne i Linköping. Gjerningsmannen forsvinner sporløst og politiet må nå finne ut hvem han er.

programme.title: Svenske krimsaker: Episode 603
programme.desc: Politiet har ikke gitt opp å oppklare dobbeltdrapet i Linköping. Etter en endring i svensk lov i 2019, har politiet nå muligheten til å bruke kommersielle slektsdatabaser for å finne gjerningsmannen.

programme.title: Svenske krimsaker: Episode 604
programme.desc: En 33 år gammel mann blir funnet skutt og drept nær Sundsvall. Det viser seg å være en mann med mange fiender, og politiets liste består i begynnelsen av over femti personer med mulige motiver.

programme.title: Svenske krimsaker: Episode 605
programme.desc: Den 12. juni 2017 blir et eldre par funnet brutalt drept på deres gård utenfor Mantorp. Viktige brikker i puslespillet i jakten på morderen viser seg å være teiprester, så vel som usedvanlig store skoavtrykk.

programme.title: Svenske krimsaker: Episode 606
programme.desc: Den siste gangen Fatima Berggren ble sett i live var på hennes 57-årsdag i mai 2017. Saken blir først betraktet som en kidnapping, men uten livstegn fra Fatima, anser politiet det snart som en drapssak.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Fortidens Fremtid Del 2
programme.desc: Når Drex forandrer unge Ray, må Henry, og nå destruktive, Ray, kjempe mot Drex og få Ray tilbake til normalen.

programme.desc: Når Ray, ved et uhell, ødelegger den fjernstyrte bilen til faren til Henry, har de et manikyr/pedikyr-selskap for å tjene penger til å fikse den.

programme.desc: Når viseordføreren kutter i budsjettet til Captain Man og Kid Danger for å bygge et høyhastighetstog, må Captain Man og Kid Danger finne kreative måter å spare penger på.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Tegneserien
programme.desc: Når Henry og Ray får en kopi av den nye Kid Danger og Captain Man tegneserien og ser at den er forferdelig, må de forte seg og fikse tegneserien før det store premiereselskapet.

programme.title: iCarly: Fektedrama
programme.desc: Freddie trenger litt guttetid, så han slår seg sammen med Spencer for å dra og fekte. Freddie er et naturtalent, men ting blir innviklet når Spencer får ham med i en kamp mot den utrolige Doug Toder.

programme.title: iCarly: Vinn en date
programme.desc: Når vennen deres Gibby er for sjenert for å be ut jenta han liker, bestemmer gjengen seg for å gjøre ham og hans flamme til deltagere i et "iWin A Date" innslag på nettvideoshowet deres

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg så han først
programme.desc: Når Carly og Sam viser interesse for den samme fyren, lover de at han ikke skal komme imellom dem. Men det er vanskelig, og når de slåss om hans oppmerksomhet, blir vennskapet deres satt på prøve.

programme.title: iCarly: Pack rat
programme.desc: Carly må trå til når Spencer blir avhengig av et videospil. Sam lurer Freddie til å tro at han blir forfulgt av uhell når han nekter å sende et kjedebrev videre.

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg skylder deg en
programme.desc: Sam blir fornærmet når Freddie beskylder henne for ikke å betale ham og Carly noen av de pengene tilbake som hun konstant låner. Sam prøver iherdig å betale dem tilbake - hun finner seg en ordentlig jobb.

programme.title: iCarly: Hubert Lewbert
programme.desc: En "Lur Lewbert"-sketsj går helt galt og skader Carlys irriterende portvakt. Gjengen pleier ham inntil Freddies mor tar over. Men når kærligheten begynner å blomstre, må de sette en stopper for det.

programme.title: iCarly: Pie
programme.desc: Når Carly, Sam og Spencer tar med Freddie til deres yndlingskonditori, finner de ut at eieren er død. Men enda verre er det at oppskriftene hans kanskje er gått tapt for alltid.

programme.title: iCarly: Jul
programme.desc: I et forsøk på å pifte opp julen med et utradisjonelt tre, kommer Spencer til å sette fyr på alle Carlys gaver. Fortvilet ønsker hun seg at hun hadde en normal bror.

programme.title: iCarly: Kysset
programme.desc: Sam overhører Freddie fortelle Carly at han aldri har kysset en jente, og avslører hemmeligheten hans på netshowet. Gibby og Carly trener Spencer til utttaket for det lokale, profesjonelle fotballaget.

programme.title: iCarly: Bilbråk
programme.desc: Gjengen holder en konkurranse på iCarly, og premien er en ny bil fra en lokal forhandler. Etter at Nevel vinner, oppdager barna at forhandleren ikke visste noe om konkurransen eller bilen de skulle ha donert bort som premie.

programme.title: iCarly: Fred
programme.desc: Freddie sier offentlig at han ikke er fan av internettsensasjonen Fred, noe som får Fred til å meddele at han skal slutte å legge ut filmer for alltid. Fansen blir rasende fordi Freddie har forårsaket slutten på de populære filmene.

programme.title: Awkward: Indecent Exposure
programme.desc: Når Matty flytter inn hos Hamiltonfamilien, oppdager Jenna at samboerskap er mer enn det hun hadde regent med.

programme.title: Awkward: That Girl Strikes Again
programme.desc: Spøkelsene fra Jennas fortid kommer fram igjen, og det gjør også hennes usikkerhet - akkurat i tide til Halloweenfeiringen i Palos Hills.

programme.title: Awkward: Guilt Trippin'
programme.desc: Jennas første kavaler til Homecomingballet roter opp gamle skyldfølelser rundt jenta hun en gang var og jentene som ikke har kavalerer.

programme.title: Awkward: Rubbed Raw and Reeling
programme.desc: En utfordring fra Mr. Hart tvinger Jenna til å eksponere seg offentlig, og dermed konfronteres hun med noen alarmerende og nye innsikter i sin person.

programme.title: Awkward: Reality Check
programme.desc: Etter en sen kaffe med Collin klarer ikke Jenna å slutte å tenke på ham, eller hva det betyr å være forelsket og det å ha en kjæreste.

programme.title: Awkward: Redefining Jenna
programme.desc: Spenningen stiger mellom Jenna og Matty når Collin inviterer henne til en snerten fotovisning hjemme hos ham selv.

programme.title: Awkward: Surprise!
programme.desc: Etter å ha klint med Collin på impuls, bestemmer Jenna seg for å slutte å være utro før Matty finner ut om det.

programme.title: Awkward: And Then What Happened
programme.desc: Hva skjedde egentlig på overraskelsesfesten - og er det virkelig helt slutt mellom Jenna og Matty? Det vet bare de to, men vennene deres prøver å finne ut sannheten.

programme.title: Awkward: Taking Sides
programme.desc: Jenna holder grillfest for at hennes venner skal venne seg til tanken på hennes og Collins spirende forhold. Men når deres støtte uteblir, tar hun drastiske midler i bruk.

programme.title: Awkward: The Bad Seed
programme.desc: Etter å ha blitt uvenner med Tamara og Ming, syns Jenna at det ikke spiller noen rolle hva hun gjør lenger - og hun havner i en vanskelig situasjon.

programme.title: Lenny Kravitz MTV Unplugged

programme.desc: Alicia Keys performs Unplugged at the Brooklyn Academy of Music.

programme.title: Paul McCartney MTV Unplugged
programme.desc: MTV Unplugged,' world premiered this one hour performance with the legendary Paul McCartney. This performance was simulcast via the Global Satellite Network. Taped on January 25, 1991 at the Limehouse Studios in London.

programme.title: John Mellencamp MTV Unplugged
programme.desc: This one-hour episode with beloved American rocker John Mellencamp was taped in Los Angeles in April of 1992, and features a medley of Mellencamp hits, past and present.

programme.desc: Med Glees Jane Lynch som Roastmaster serveres brutale fornærmelser, og Barrs eks-mann Tom Arnold dukker opp for å harselere med sin eks-kone.

programme.title: The Roast of William Shatner
programme.desc: The Roast of William Shatner ble nominert til en Primetime Emmy Award i 2007, i kategorien Outstanding Variety Special. Her blir skuespilleren plassert i rampelyset når roastmaster Jason Alexander og en gruppe komikere jekker ham ned noen hakk.

programme.title: Another Period: Annulment
programme.desc: Lillian og Beatrices ekteskap blir annullert, samt Lillian og Victor krangler om deres dyrebare 'Butternut' - rommet. Beatrice hjelper Albert med å komme over øksefobien, og Garfield krangler med en tvilsom ny tjener.

programme.title: Another Period: The Prince And The Pauper
programme.desc: Huset Commodore inviterer en prins til Bellacourt Manor. Det starter en intens rivalisering mellom Lillian og Beatrice. Peepers gir prinsens tjener motbør angående korrekte butler-metoder, og Hamishs cellekamerat prøver å lære ham å lese.

programme.title: Another Period: Trial of the Century
programme.desc: Hamish står for retten for mordet på Scoops LaPue. Lillian prøver å bruke saken for å skape blest om egen person, og Peepers nyter en siste dag i frihet før han prøver å påta seg skylden for forbrytelsen.

programme.title: Detroiters: Dream Cruise
programme.desc: Når de ansatte truer med å slutte på grunn av manglende helseforsikring, forsøker Tim og Sam å samle inn pengene de skylder fra tidligere jobber. Deres innsats forvanskes av Detroits årlige 'Dream Cruise'-bilshow. Gjest er Cecily Strong.

programme.title: Detroiters: Husky Boys
programme.desc: Tims far - 'Big Hank' - kommer uventet tilbake fra galehuset under mistenkelige forhold. Tim og Sam sliter med en å skape et slagord for en varehus-reklame som henvender seg til store, sterke karer.

programme.title: Detroiters: Quick Rick Mahorn in Dearborn
programme.desc: Tim og Sam oppdager at Chrysler-sjefen de kjørte over har hatt det forferdelig siden. Etter å ha vært med i en av reklamene, får Piston-legenden Rick Mahorn skuespillerambisjoner. Gjester er Jason Sudeikis, Rick Mahorn og Richard Karn.
